query:
SELECT 
  total_students,
  has_phone,
  no_phone,
  has_password,
  no_password
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_students,
    SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_phone,
    SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NULL OR phone = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_phone,
    SUM(CASE WHEN password IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_password,
    SUM(CASE WHEN password IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_password
  FROM students
) t;
